title: Approve substitute ball valve with a wider body
description: The specified valve has a 14-week lead time. The substitute body is 25 mm wider and protrudes into the wall cavity.

analysis.situation: Substituting the valve avoids a 14-week delay; the wider body needs a 25 mm cavity allowance.
analysis.riskIfUnresolved: Mechanical rough-in on level 2 stops on Friday.

preApproval.condition: Cavity allowance at or below 30 mm

analysis.recommendedAction: Approve the substitute and record the cavity allowance as a tolerance override.
